background: Brazilian former NBA center (Spurs 2010-15, 2014 champion; Hawks 2015-17) who moved into coaching as a Brooklyn Nets assistant (2019-23, big-man/player development under Atkinson and Vaughn), a Houston Rockets assistant (2023-24 under Udoka), and head coach of Paris Basketball (2024-25, French Cup champion). Joined Portland as an assistant under Chauncey Billups in summer 2025 and was elevated to interim head coach on Oct. 23, 2025 after Billups' arrest; coached the Blazers to a 42-40 record (30-21 with a top-10 defense over the final 51 games), an 8th-seed playoff berth and a 1-4 first-round loss to San Antonio. Hired by the Bulls on June 16, 2026 (introduced June 17) as the first head-coaching hire of new EVP Bryson Graham, replacing Billy Donovan. Identity as a coach: up-tempo offense, extremely aggressive full-court-pressure defense, relationship-driven culture, strong trust in young players.
